name: GET RID
description:
About This Game

Enter a sprawling, corrupt metropolis where the only goal is to cleanse the city. Battle through a dystopia where the threats never stop changing. In this action-roguelite, adaptation is key—one moment you are slicing through mobs, the next you are unloading heavy weaponry into a massive boss.

Key Features

  • Slash & Shoot: Seamlessly switch between close-quarters melee combat and ranged firepower. Master the rhythm of the hybrid combat system to dominate the battlefield.

  • Build Your Arsenal: No two runs are alike. Scavenge a vast array of weapons and modify them with volatile traits. Will you build a balanced loadout, or stack modifiers to create a "broken," overpowered build that melts bosses in seconds?

  • Evolving Threats: The city fights back. Roguelite elements ensure that enemy types and behaviors evolve as you progress. The strategy that worked in the Outskirts might get you killed in the Underground.

  • Conquer the Metropolis: Fight your way through three distinct regions—the desolate Outskirts, the claustrophobic Underground, and the neon-lit Downtown—each guarded by unique enemy rosters and grueling boss encounters.
short_desc: In GET RID, master the deadly rhythm of brutal melee and third-person shooting. Enhance your arsenal with volatile traits and weave between blade and bullet to slaughter your enemies. Ascend from the gutters to the city's soaring skyline and GET RID of anyone standing in your way.
